description:
The legend is on two wheels! As riders will expect from a Bronco, it’s got the trail-ready performance to match its off-road heritage: Whether you’re exploring OHV trails or heading to a distant fishing hole, the Bronco is fully capable and ready for adventure.
Bronco puts 500W* of electric boost under the rider. 85Nm of torque provides the acceleration needed for quick starts on rough terrain and makes quick work of the climb. The maximum assisted speed of 32 KM/H** will make trails and forest tracks pass effortlessly. Custom G.O.A.T. ™ (Goes Over Any Type of Terrain) inspired suspension lets riders maximize the bike’s power by keeping the wheels on the ground over small rocks, while the air-sprung fork and coil rear shock are ready to tackle more challenging terrain.
The Bronco’s unique, moto-style saddle makes it easy for riders to perfectly position their weight on the bike and muscle over or around obstacles. Pirelli Scorpion Enduro M Hardwall tires provide plenty of traction to let riders claw over roots, rocks, and riverbeds, and Tektro 4-piston disc brakes keep the speed in check when needed.
Riders can explore backwoods, canyons, and trails all day with a 48V, 15Ah | 720Wh battery that provides up to 100*** KM of range, depending on usage and conditions. The custom handlebar-mounted display is inspired by Ford's infotainment system and makes it easy for riders to see essential vehicle performance data while riding.
Bronco is available in one size that fits any rider between 5'4" and 6'5".

e_vehicle_motor.description: 500W* Motor with four modes: Eco, Normal, Sport, and Baja
